exclude.label: Does not contain
exclude.placeholder: A value the records must not contain
exclude.hint: In the request list it removes a whole request if any of its records has the value. In “All records” it removes only those lines, like != in Grafana.
exclude.hintBrief: Removes a whole request from the list if any of its records has the value.

error.too-short: The value is too short: at least 2 characters are needed.
error.too-long: The value is too long: no more than 1000 characters.
error.forbidden-char: Quotes and backslashes are not allowed: they are escaped in logs.
error.pan-hidden: The card number is not kept after a page reload. Remove it and enter it again.
error.conflict: This value is in the search: the result would be empty.

filters.label: Result filters
filters.allHidden: All rows are hidden by filters.

curl.label: Copy as cURL
curl.hint: Method, address, headers and body, as on screen.
curl.masked: Hidden values are copied masked. To copy them in the clear, first reveal them with the eye icon.
curl.noHost: The record only has a path: add the host.
